unknownFields: Preserved unsupported pending complete governing classification
functionAdmission: Original function has one to three input arguments: first source type, optional second native integer typmod, optional third native boolean explicitness; result target type. Resolve actual argument modes/kind and native type identities, not hardcoded OIDs or names. Same source/target type is legitimate for multiargument length coercion; no universal inequality rule.
methodAdmission: f resolves full routine/signature/executable/authority closure; i resolves source output and target input routine definitions and relevant type/typmod context despite zero castfunc; b preserves native binary coercion direction and separately admits physical/type representation meaning. Zero castfunc never means no dependency or universal identity conversion.
additionalRequiredDefinitions: complete source/target type and typmod meaning
canonicalProducer: Resolved source/target definition identities plus exact context/method and method-specific routine/representation definition. Preserve direction and self-type length coercion. Raw object IDs never cross-install semantics; compatible signatures do not establish losslessness.
absencePolicy: No pg_cast row is not proof a conversion is impossible; domain/base and generic automatic I/O paths require separately admitted native rules. This collector does not enumerate generic rules or select SQL coercion paths. Weft owns compiler lowering.
observationPolicy: No conversion, cast-function or I/O invocation during discovery; no inference of codec, key equality, losslessness or execution permission from castcontext.
